The native DeathFallOff path deactivated enClam at reviewed frame 24 before Clam_DeathDirect became visually available, so this archive accepts a clean hide-and-debris handoff without claiming a visible articulated corpse pose.

The closest native attacks pass behind the top HUD and bright effects or the foreground hero limit fine surface inspection; no viewport-edge clipping, hinge separation, tearing, or renderer loss was observed in the reviewed frames.
DeathLight, DeathRevive, portrait, collision, extended culling, long-session resource lifetime, full campaign completion, and final art-direction approval remain outside this archive.
